settings.workspace.label: Special workspace
settings.workspace.description: Hyprland special workspace Pi Companion lives in. Both "pi" and "special:pi" work.
settings.terminal.label: Terminal
settings.terminal.description: Terminal emulator the spawned Pi runs in, for example foot, kitty or alacritty.
settings.spawn.label: Spawn command
settings.spawn.description: Command run inside the terminal. The plugin adds PI_HYPR_MONITOR=1 so the companion extension publishes the status file; a pinned --session-dir keeps the companion session separate from your other Pi sessions.
settings.working_dir.label: Working directory
settings.working_dir.description: Directory the spawned Pi starts in. The default is your home directory.
settings.geometry.label: Window size
settings.geometry.description: Floating size of the companion window, as WIDTHxHEIGHT, for example 900x600.
settings.vertical_alignment.label: Vertical alignment
settings.vertical_alignment.description: Place the companion at the top, center or bottom of the monitor whenever it is shown.
settings.horizontal_alignment.label: Horizontal alignment
settings.horizontal_alignment.descriptio: Place the companion at the left, center or right of the monitor whenever it is shown.
settings.notify.label: Notify when Pi starts waiting
settings.notify.description: Send a notification when Pi changes to waiting while the special workspace is hidden. Nothing is sent while it is on screen.
